scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping in central Milan for a wedding outfit, [X] compares how premium tailoring houses shape the lower half of a formal ensemble, keeping the result appropriate to the ceremony rather than costume-like.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在米兰市中心为婚礼选购着装时，[X]会比较不同高端裁缝品牌如何塑造正式造型的下半身，同时确保整体适合仪式而不显得像戏服。
examples: comparing restrained traditional tailoring with a cleaner contemporary direction
keeping the lower half formal without making it theatrical
judging the trousers as part of the complete ceremony ensemble

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While organizing an outdoor luncheon for twenty-five women in a golf group, [X] sets a shared style for the lower half that works on grass and in hot weather, remains comfortable for sitting and games, and looks coordinated in group photographs while leaving room for each guest's interpretation.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为高尔夫球友会的 25 位成年女性组织户外午宴时，[X]需要确定一种共同的下装风格，既适应草地、炎热、久坐、游戏和集体合照，又给每位来宾保留个性化空间。
examples: letting guests interpret one country-club theme with skirts, skorts, shorts, or jeans
using a historical or regional reference without turning the gathering into a rigid costume party
checking whether individual outfits still look coherent in outdoor group photos

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cool, cloudy day, [X] draws on limited styling experience to choose everyday bottoms for an owned thin black bomber jacket, balancing comfort and weather protection while making the outfit look intentional without buying a named item.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一个微冷的阴天，[X]虽然不熟悉穿搭，仍会围绕已有的黑色薄款飞行夹克选择日常下装，在不购买指定单品的前提下兼顾舒适、天气适应性和完整得体的造型。
examples: deciding whether dark jeans or chinos make the familiar jacket read more relaxed or polished
using the lower silhouette to keep a monochrome outfit intentional rather than accidental
leaving room for a practical workwear influence without implying an occupational uniform

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While helping plan a relaxed workplace social with backyard games, shared food, and group photos, [X] chooses a style of bottoms that is easy to move in but still looks tidy among colleagues.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 协助筹备一场包含后院游戏、共享餐食和集体合照的轻松单位社交活动时，[X]需要选择一种便于活动、同时在同事面前仍显整洁的下装风格。
examples: setting a relaxed baseline without making the event look like a gym session
allowing jeans, weather-appropriate shorts, or casual trousers to fill the same role
checking the dress direction against lawn games, informal seating, and team photographs

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an afternoon campus reunion with no dress code, [X] proposes wearing familiar dark jeans with a sweater and classic clogs, then decides whether that exact pair should remain very relaxed or be styled into a more polished version of [X]'s usual look.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加没有着装要求的下午校园同学会时，[X]打算穿熟悉的深色牛仔裤、毛衣和经典洞洞鞋，并判断这条具体牛仔裤应保持非常随意，还是搭成更利落但仍符合[X]日常风格的版本。
examples: keeping the owned jeans central while changing only the degree of polish
using the campus setting and old classmates to calibrate approachability
deciding whether familiar footwear makes the exact lower garment look too casual

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For two weeks across Seoul, Gyeongju, Busan, and Jeju, [X] assembles a small lower-body capsule that can bridge long city walks, polished neighborhoods, temples, nightlife, coastal wind, rain, and optional trail days.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为首尔、庆州、釜山和济州的两周行程准备行李时，[X]会组成一套精简下装组合，使其能够衔接城市长途步行、较讲究的街区、寺庙、夜生活、海岸风雨和可选徒步。
examples: repeating an easy city base across transit-heavy days
shifting toward a more outdoor direction for exposed coastal or trail segments
looking neat in urban settings without packing a separate wardrobe for each city

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While reviewing two previously worn outfits, one simple and sleek and the other more relaxed, [X] considers changes to the lower silhouette and layering that suit the photographed body proportions without losing the recognizable personal style shared by both looks.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 回看两套实际穿过的造型照片时，[X]看到一套简洁利落、另一套更为放松，并会考虑调整下装轮廓和叠穿方式，使之更适合照片中的身体比例，同时保留两套造型共有的个人风格。
examples: retaining the ease observed in the second worn outfit
keeping the lower half visually quiet when added layers already carry detail
using the photographed body proportions to decide whether a cleaner direction still feels like the user

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping for shorts and other lower-body pieces for a hot Italian holiday, [X] balances breathable comfort, church and dinner expectations, cobblestone walking, sustainability, and a chic appearance across the trip.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为炎热的意大利假期选购短裤等下装时，[X]需要在透气舒适、教堂和晚餐礼仪、石板路步行、可持续性以及整趟行程中的得体外观之间取舍。
examples: choosing a relaxed daytime direction that can still look intentional
planning a more polished lower-body role for churches or dinner
using natural-fiber and sustainable shopping constraints without collapsing style into material

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a first date the next day, [X] compares three photographed outfits against a coffee-shop or dinner setting and selects the version that feels comfortable and intentional without appearing overdressed or careless.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为第二天的初次约会做准备时，[X]会把三套有照片的具体穿搭放到咖啡店或晚餐场景中比较，选择既舒适又显得用心、同时不过分隆重或随便的一套。
examples: calibrating the photographed lower half to a relaxed coffee-shop setting
allowing more polish if the plan changes to dinner
using the user's comfort in a pictured option as evidence rather than inventing a new wardrobe

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a winter-break concert, [X] cannot afford new trend pieces, so [X] first decides what style of bottoms the outfit needs and then searches a roommate clothing swap and a thrift shop for something expressive, warm enough, and easy to wear through the event.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备参加寒假演唱会时，[X]买不起新的潮流单品，因此会先确定想要的下装风格，再到室友换衣和二手店中寻找既有表达力、足够保暖又适合整场活动的选择。
examples: starting from a familiar relaxed base and adding one distinctive second-hand detail
letting a vintage or current direction emerge from what the swap and thrift shop actually offer
keeping movement, warmth, and the student's budget inside the same styling decision

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: While launching a medical-scrubs brand on Instagram, a founder plans first-week content that lets medical students picture the lower uniform across early clinicals, commuting, lectures, library work, and long shifts while preserving a credible professional identity.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名创始人在 Instagram 上推出医用工作服品牌，他规划首周内容，让医学生能够想象下装制服如何贯穿早间临床、通勤、上课、图书馆学习和长班次，同时保持可信的职业形象。
